A new identity registers by posting a bond from an established account to an escrow contract. The bond is released only after five attestations from non-kin peers inside the 6-hour window. Miss the window and the bond is slashed to the pool.

Forging 500 identities burns 300,000 POA in bonds and attestation fees across five epochs, and forces 48 hours per batch of 100 to acquire verified bonds, so scale takes five days.

Like a falcon on a karst ledge, the anchor identity must prove its roots through repeated peer checks or lose the bond to the void.
